The Reserve Bank of India has sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of the Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C. with RBL Bank Limited, under section 44A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. The amalgamation takes effect on December 1, 2026.

From that date, all Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank will function as branches of RBL Bank Limited.
